title: Shopify Store & Product Catalog Spy Input

startUrls.title: Shopify Store URLs / Domains
startUrls.description: List of Shopify store URLs or domains (e.g., https://allbirds.com, gymshark.com, or specific collections like https://kith.com/collections/mens).

maxProductsPerStore.title: Max Products Per Store
maxProductsPerStore.description: Maximum number of products to extract per store.

onlyInStock.title: Only In-Stock Products
onlyInStock.description: If enabled, only products with at least one variant available in stock will be returned.

searchKeyword.title: Keyword Filter (Optional)
searchKeyword.description: Filter products containing this keyword in the title, tags, or vendor (case-insensitive).

publishedAfter.title: Published After Date (Optional)
publishedAfter.description: Filter products published after this date (ISO format YYYY-MM-DD, e.g., 2026-01-01) to identify new arrivals.

flattenVariants.title: Flatten Output by Variant
flattenVariants.description: If true, each variant becomes a separate dataset row (ideal for SKU/inventory tracking). If false, each product is one row with variants nested.
